patches.name: 100 Zoom Earth favourites
patches.description: Raises the visible and add-location limits from 3 free / 30 Pro to 100 saved places. Keeps existing saved data and works independently of Pro. Phone testing pending.

compatiblePackages.name: Zoom Earth

Walmart Canada 26.31, Anker eufy 6.1.20_31181 and Gmail 2026.10.26.1012468012.Release open verified APKMirror APKM pages; other versions/apps use a package-and-version Google search restricted to APKMirror, without nodpi. compatiblePackages.name: Morphe Manager
compatiblePackages.description: Optional APKMirror search fix; use the official Manager APK from GitHub.

patches.name: Aisle-Sorted Checklist — Canada
patches.description: Group remaining checklist items by supplied aisle, in natural order (A2 before A10). Unknown locations last. No floor-plan routing.

patches.name: Allow TAGTHAi accessibility apps
patches.description: Normalizes the local accessibility result after AppGuard completes its check. Intended for accessibility services installed from any source. Other sideloaded-app restrictions and server Play Integrity checks are not bypassed. Phone testing pending.

compatiblePackages.name: TAGTHAi

compatiblePackages.name: TAGTHAi
compatiblePackages.description: Original 4.25.1 (4251001), including its device splits. Phone testing pending.

patches.name: Allow Zoom Earth patched installation
patches.description: Experimental original-APK startup attempt; dev.10 still showed Get this app from Play on the phone. Do not select for the working LiteAPKs APK. Disables two local checks, preserves native VM assets and does not grant paid server access.

compatiblePackages.name: Zoom Earth
compatiblePackages.description: Original 6.3.3 (52) DEX required; experimental startup compatibility patch.

patches.name: Clearer Unit Prices — Canada
patches.description: Show Walmart's supplied price-per-unit in larger bold text on list items, including the shopping checklist. No guessed conversions.

patches.name: Default Lists Tab — Canada
patches.description: Open Lists when entering My Items. Walmart Canada 26.31 and 26.41.2.

patches.name: Disable Expo updates and backup restore
patches.description: Forces the app to use the bundled local Hermes asset instead of cached Expo OTA updates or restored app data.

patches.name: Disable Gboard floating and one-handed modes
patches.description: Suppresses long-press popups containing one-handed mode, including holding Enter, and prevents automatic, toolbar and restored floating or one-handed keyboard activation. Select alongside your usual Gboard patches on the original Gboard APK. Preserves normal and split modes. Phone testing pending.

compatiblePackages.name: Gboard
compatiblePackages.description: Optional add-on for stock Gboard 18.5.4 arm64. Can be selected with the standard Gboard patches, including GboardWu package rename, in one run.

patches.name: Disable Wongnai Google ads
patches.description: Stops the identified Google banner, native and interstitial ad loaders in Wongnai 12.11.0, and uses its existing photo-ad fallback.

patches.name: Disable ad SDK manifest components
patches.description: Disables bundled ad mediation components and removes ad identifier/ad services permissions.

patches.name: Disable ad and promo remote config
patches.description: Blackholes ad/paywall/reward feature-flag keys and remote promo payload keys so the app cannot enable ad or upsell surfaces from remote config.

patches.name: Enable GPS Emulator Pro
patches.description: GPS Emulator 3.36 (336): enables the app's shared Pro setting and 1,000 favourites at startup, and prevents billing callbacks from resetting Pro settings. Built against the original APKMirror APKM. Phone testing pending.

patches.name: Enable Pro file-type handling
patches.description: Open with 1.2.1 (11) local test: enables the shared Pro flag used by file-type settings and routing, and removes the two Play installation licence startup calls for a re-signed build. Phone testing pending.

patches.name: Enable Songsterr premium features
patches.description: Songsterr 7.1.6 (2012282388): selects the highest local access tier for player controls, premium UI and ad gating. Does not grant a server subscription, AI quota or unavailable content. Requires the verified original split bundle; phone testing pending.

compatiblePackages.name: Songsterr
compatiblePackages.description: Original 7.1.6 (2012282388) split bundle, or its merged APK. Keep all native/resource splits.

patches.name: Enable Zoom Earth Pro features
patches.description: Enables local Pro controls, hides Pro upsells and permits up to ten daily forecast rows when data is supplied. Paid radar/model data still uses the real account entitlement; this does not create a subscription. Phone testing pending.

compatiblePackages.name: Zoom Earth
compatiblePackages.description: Verified 6.3.3 (52) original archive or supplied working LiteAPKs APK; experimental.

patches.name: Find Item for Linked Items — Canada
patches.description: Restore Find item on linked shopping-list products so they can be linked to a different product.

patches.name: Gmail account visibility
patches.description: Adds Account visibility to Gmail settings and a long press on the account avatar. Hide or show individual switcher accounts, with Show all recovery. Keeps the current account visible. Does not hide mail, All inboxes, notifications or Android accounts. Creates a separate GmsCore copy; phone testing pending.

compatiblePackages.name: Gmail
compatiblePackages.description: Original APKMirror arm64 build 66141086. Separate no-root copy requires ReVanced GmsCore. Sign-in, sync and phone UI testing are pending.

patches.name: Hermes hide ad promo surfaces
patches.description: Experimental Hermes bytecode edit: makes ad-card components return null. May prevent startup; opt in only for testing.

patches.name: Hide Ads and Sponsored Content — Canada
patches.description: Collapse native ad containers and entire sponsored grid/list product cards, restoring organic cards when recycled. Includes display ads and sponsored carousels. Does not block network requests; some layouts may retain empty slots.

patches.name: Hide Eufy Discover, Smart and Shop
patches.description: Hides Discover, Smart and Shop in the main bottom navigation, retaining original tab indices. Restored hidden tabs return to Home. Other Smart controls, cameras, events and Profile are preserved. Phone testing pending.

compatiblePackages.name: Anker eufy
compatiblePackages.description: Original APKMirror 6.1.20_31181 (31181), including its asset-pack split. Experimental UI cleanup; protected startup and camera operation need phone testing.

patches.name: Hide Eufy promotions
patches.description: Collapses the identified camera-home marketing and AI offer banners and promotional inbox cards, and closes the identified shopping and solar-panel offer popups. No network blocking or notification filtering; remote/React Native offers may remain. Phone testing pending.

compatiblePackages.name: Anker eufy
compatiblePackages.description: Original APKMirror 6.1.20_31181 (31181), including its asset-pack split. Experimental UI cleanup; protected startup and camera operation need phone testing.

patches.name: Merge XAPK only
patches.description: Makes no app-code or resource edits. Morphe merges APK components and signs the result with your key. The original signature is not preserved. Separate OBB/game data is not installed.

patches.name: Neutralize bundled ad unit IDs and premium banners
patches.description: Replaces bundled ad unit IDs and premium/reward banner copy in the Hermes bundle with same-length non-serving/blank values while leaving the AdMob app ID intact.

patches.name: Neutralize premium and reward-ad prompts
patches.description: Force-removes the remaining premium/reward banner strings from the bundled Hermes asset.

patches.name: Patch Tools — Canada
patches.description: Replace Sparky with a card-based tools menu: stock checker, barcode scanner, price history, shopping calculators, settings and backups. Includes Back navigation and dark-mode support.

patches.name: Personal Price History — Canada
patches.description: Record exact prices from list cards and search/browse product tiles. Tap History on list cards, or Patch tools → Price history. Recording starts after installation.

patches.name: Pin local Expo config
patches.description: Neutralizes Expo OTA update configuration in the bundled Expo config so the APK prefers local bundled assets.

patches.name: Promotion Cleanup — Canada
patches.description: Collapse the shopping-list deals promotional banner. Product discounts, expiry conditions, rewards, totals and checkout are preserved. Not an app-wide ad blocker.

patches.name: Quick Scanner — Canada
patches.description: Add a Scan barcode shortcut to the shopping checklist, opening Walmart's native scanner and permission flow.

patches.name: Quiet Zoom Earth prompts
patches.description: Disables automatic subscription popups and review requests. Manual subscription actions, permission prompts and weather/outage notices remain available. Phone testing pending.

patches.name: Running List Total — Canada

patches.name: Sale-Ending Reminders — Canada

patches.name: Shopping Mode — Canada

patches.name: Stock Availability — Canada
patches.description: Show list availability. On 26.41.2, read product-detail quantities into Patch tools → Stock checker with separate pickup, delivery and shipping labels. Missing numbers stay unknown; no watchlist or order-limit guesses.
